about: Verdicts for findings on the bench's local pages (demos, templates, compat apps), by page, kind and selector (viewport and scheme when the verdict depends on them). real: the page has that bug (it is left alone, AGENTS.md rule 4); false: a check error. An unlabelled finding counts as a false report. Public sites are never labelled here (VISUAL.md 15).
